content:
ana: Heads up — new customer hit our quickstart. They created a workspace via SSO and expected trial credits. First request returned 402 with x-workspace-status=billing_required, then the Python SDK retried and user saw 504.

lee_devx: Which Python SDK version? Can you paste the minimal repro?

ana: (typo) sorry, ana. Python SDK 0.9.4. Repro with curl as well. Curl: 

```
$ curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'

* Connected to api.redwood.ai
< HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
< x-workspace-status: billing_required
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"payment_required"}
* Connection #0 to host api.redwood.ai left intact

# SDK did an automatic retry which produced a 504/timeout in the client UI.
```

lee_devx: SDK should not be retrying on 4xx. Do you have a log snippet from the client showing the retry behavior?

ana: From the app logs: 

```
2026-03-23T16:10:01Z DEBUG redwood.client: request start -> POST /v1/generate
2026-03-23T16:10:01Z INFO  redwood.client: response 402 {"error":"payment_required"} headers:{'x-workspace-status':'billing_required'}
2026-03-23T16:10:01Z DEBUG redwood.retry: scheduling retry #1 for status 402
2026-03-23T16:10:05Z ERROR app.ui: request failed after retry -> 504 gateway timeout
```

yusuf: Wait, log shows retry scheduled on 402. That matches an old helper that treats any non-2xx as retryable. We changed that in node but maybe python still has the old logic.

ops-bot: pinging infra-edge with trace id tr_2112222222-a1 for header forwarding investigation.

devex-bot: quick audit returned: initial control-plane response = 402 with x-workspace-status=billing_required. SDK retry emitted a fresh request but the edge removed Authorization header (policy: drop on internal retry) leading to 401 at auth-gateway which surfaced as 504 downstream in the runtime path.

lee_devx: So two separate issues: (A) SDK retry policy treats 402 as retryable (incorrect), (B) edge policy drops auth headers on repeated requests causing downstream failures.

ana: Immediate ask: can we publish a user-facing workaround (console notice) and ship a small patch to the Python SDK to treat 4xx as terminal? I can draft the PR for the SDK.

yusuf: I'll open an edge ticket to stop authority header stripping on retries or at least preserve Authorization for same-origin retry. I'll add the trace and suggest a defensive check that re-injects x-workspace-status into logs.

devex-bot: Recorded: issue-sdk-412 (python retry policy), infra-798 (edge header preservation).

lee_devx: For the SDK patch: change retry predicate to `is_retryable = status >=500 || network_error` and add explicit test for 402/403 behaviors. Also emit a BillingError that includes x-workspace-status when present.

ana: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/222 (draft). Tests included.

yusuf: I'll follow up with a short doc patch to onboarding: show "Billing: not enabled" and link to the billing setup flow so new SSO-created orgs don't get surprised.

ana: Thanks team. I'll also email the SE who owns the account to confirm they thought trial credits applied.

lee_devx: Keeping thread open until both PR and infra ticket are closed. If anyone finds a reproducer, drop trace id here.

devex-bot: tagging owners: @lee_devx (SDK), @yusuf (infra).
